QuestInfo.name: [Knight Stronghold] Scouting the Stronghold
QuestInfo.0: #bChief Alex#k, in the #bHenesys Ruins#k of the Gate to the Future, seems to need help. Go see him.
QuestInfo.1: Chief Alex wants you to scout out the Cygnus Knights, as they've been suspiciously quiet lately. Take the #bCrossroads of Ereve towards the stronghold#k .
QuestInfo.2: You told Chief Alex what you saw in the stronghold.

no.0: If Henesys falls, who will be left...?

1.0: Did you scout the Cygnus Knights' stronghold? Did you see any movement?

yes.0: Hm. It sounds like security has tightened, but we still need to find a way in to know more about what's going on...

quest.0: You went the wrong way. You need to pass #bCrossroads of Ereve#k, towards the stronghold.
